world_a_do_nothing.description: Status quo: no intervention taken; attacker continues progression unabated toward crown jewels

assumptions: Attacker progression continues unhindered without defensive friction
simulation_provenance.projected_reachability_summary: All 4 reachable assets remain exposed; Tier-0 compromised

continuation_basis: No defensive friction or containment controls applied

intervention_worlds.description: Network-level host isolation of foothold workstation; cuts all inbound/outbound communication
residual_attack_paths: Cached cloud tokens or stolen credentials usable outside isolated host
continuation_basis: Cached cloud tokens or stolen credentials remain usable outside host

intervention_worlds.description: Revoke Kerberos TGTs, OAuth refresh tokens, and force credential invalidation
residual_attack_paths: Local persistence on host survives identity revocation

assumptions: Active Directory KDC and Cloud IdP enforce immediate token revocation

continuation_basis: Local persistence on foothold host survives session reset

intervention_worlds.description: Targeted microsegmentation: block SMB/RPC to Tier-0 assets while keeping user workstation online
residual_attack_paths: Peer workstation lateral traversal remains open outside Tier-0 boundary

assumptions: Software-defined perimeter / switch ACL can enforce port blocks dynamically
simulation_provenance.projected_reachability_summary: Severed Tier-0 lateral routes; 1 peer assets reachable

intervention_worlds.description: Composite surgical containment: concurrent identity session revocation and Tier-0 route blocking

assumptions: Composite orchestration: IdP session purge + network access control synchronized
simulation_provenance.projected_reachability_summary: All lateral paths to crown jewels severed; sessions revoked

ratings.rationale: No intervention taken; attacker has unconstrained reach to crown jewels
Blunt containment severs all host network routes but causes heavy business disruption
Surgical identity invalidation halts credential pivot with moderate user friction
Targeted port blocks insulate Tier-0 assets with minimal disruption to workstation operations
Pareto-optimal: maximal attack interruption with balanced, reversible disruption
